item.title: Nigeria Customs clarifies CBN sets rates for cargo clearance
item.description: The Nigeria Customs Service has clarified that it does not set cargo clearance rates, saying the Central Bank of Nigeria is solely responsible for determining rates applied in import and export valuation.
